title: 第15章 神仙法术
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
陈建业很快便安排好了去军区医院的时间。

    联系上郁嘉庆后，询问了过郁凡的时间后，便派人前去接郁凡。

    很快几人经过重重检验，进入了军区医院。

    海市军区医院里面接受治疗的都是一些军事大佬级人物。

    郁嘉庆没想到要救的人会在军区医院，他很清楚能进入这种医院的必定是和官方有关的人。

    他连忙给他还不懂俗事的爸爸科普了一番。

    郁凡知道自己要救的人是极有可能是一个官方人员，不由暗自腹诽，果然是能更进一步接近上层的人，他的感觉没有错。

    在海市光有钱可是没有用的，可以说海市有钱的人很多，可是有钱没权一样落人下层。

    郁凡闭眼以神识观察了一番周围的环境，看到了不少有着伤痛的政要人员在内，如果将这些人收入自己麾下，倒是一个不错的事情。

    郁凡被引到了陈子轩所在的病房外。

    陈建业已经等候多时了，看到郁凡来了，他连忙上前，让主治医生将自己的情况讲述给郁凡听。

    谁知郁凡并未认真去听，而是从病房的玻璃窗外仔细审视了一番陈子航的情况。

    看到郁凡根本不曾认真听病人的真实情况，主治医生不由暗自撇嘴，又是一个不懂装懂的。

    虽然他很能理解陈老爷子的心理，可也没法认同他病急乱投医这种事。

    陈子轩目前的状况不太好，五脏内腑都有严重的损伤，更不用提已经残缺的身体。

    郁凡都有些吃惊这人能在这种状态下还能生存下来，显然是个毅力极为坚定的人。

    并且，这人明显受到过很严重的酷刑。

    郁凡对于这种有着极为强大毅力的人，是比较欣赏的。

    正当他准备推门而入时，陈建业阻止了他，他神色有些为难，但还是开口告诉了郁凡情况。

    “郁神医，根据军区医院的检测，他体内可能携带传染性病毒，需要做好防护才能进去。”
content_en:
Chen Jianye quickly arranged a time to go to the military hospital.

After contacting Yu Jiaqing and asking Yu Fan's time, he sent someone to pick up Yu Fan.

Soon, several people passed numerous tests and entered the military hospital.

The people receiving treatment in the Haicheng Military Region Hospital are all military bosses.

Yu Jiaqing did not expect that the person he wanted to save would be in a military hospital. He knew very well that those who could enter such a hospital must be people related to the government.

He quickly gave his father, who didn't understand secular things, some popular science.

Yu Fan knew that the person he wanted to save was most likely an official, so he couldn't help but secretly curse. He was indeed someone who could get closer to the upper class. His feeling was correct.

It is useless to have money in Haishi. It can be said that there are many rich people in Haishi, but even if they have money but no power, they will still fall into the lower class.

Yu Fan closed his eyes and observed the surrounding environment with his spiritual consciousness. He saw many dignitaries who were suffering from pain. It would be a good thing to bring these people under his command.

Yu Fan was led outside the ward where Chen Zixuan was.

Chen Jianye had been waiting for a long time. When he saw Yu Fan coming, he quickly stepped forward and asked the attending doctor to tell Yu Fan his situation.

Unexpectedly, Yu Fan did not listen carefully, but carefully examined Chen Zihang's situation from the glass window of the ward.

Seeing that Yu Fan didn't listen carefully to the patient's true condition, the attending doctor couldn't help but curl his lips secretly. He was another one who didn't know how to pretend to understand.

Although he could understand Mr. Chen's psychology, he couldn't agree with his urgent need to seek medical treatment.

Chen Zixuan's current condition is not very good, his internal organs are severely damaged, not to mention his body is already mutilated.

Yu Fan was a little surprised that this person could survive in this state. He was obviously a very determined person.

Moreover, this man had obviously been severely tortured.

Yu Fan admires people with extremely strong perseverance.

Just as he was about to open the door and enter, Chen Jianye stopped him. He looked a little embarrassed, but he still told Yu Fan the situation.

"Doctor Yu, according to the test at the military hospital, he may be carrying infectious viruses in his body, and he needs to be protected before entering."
